answer: Coordination rent schedule. Each agent ID pays a nonrefundable rent per action window; rent rises with distinct IDs sharing a recipient and timing bucket. A cross-shard voyage pays per destination shard. Identity graphs mirror action timing, slotting correlated IDs into one window. The public terrace caps windows and publishes occupancy. An attacker buying N IDs to sway one target pays N rents plus audit penalties for collisions; isolated actions remain cheap.
